image_description: A close-up, horizontal view of a vintage audio cassette tape resting on a textured red surface. The cassette has a dark gray/black plastic body with a cream-colored paper label on the top half. The internal spools and magnetic tape are visible through two circular windows. There is a rectangular opening at the bottom for the tape head. Faint digital timestamp text '2179 AM' is visible in the bottom left corner.
